findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_disruptions, get_spot_conditions, search_web, extract_url, submit_feedback, search_destination_sentiment, list_disruption_events, list_disruption_webhooks, delete_disruption_webhook · Private data: compare_search, vote_comparison, search_web, extract_url, remember, log_outcome, search_destination_sentiment, list_standing_queries, list_disruption_events, register_disruption_webhook, list_disruption_webhooks · Public sink: search_web, submit_feedback, register_disruption_webhook, list_disruption_webhooks, delete_disruption_webhook · Destructive: compare_search, get_camera_visibility, search_web, extract_url, delete_standing_query, delete_disruption_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_disruptions, get_spot_conditions, search_web, extract_url, submit_feedback, search_destination_sentiment, list_disruption_events, list_disruption_webhooks, delete_disruption_webhook · Private data: compare_search, vote_comparison, search_web, extract_url, remember, log_outcome, search_destination_sentiment, list_standing_queries, list_disruption_events, register_disruption_webhook, list_disruption_webhooks · Public sink: search_web, submit_feedback, register_disruption_webhook, list_disruption_webhooks, delete_disruption_webhook · Destructive: compare_search, get_camera_visibility, search_web, extract_url, delete_standing_query, delete_disruption_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
